articles.title: VAPORESSO Unveils ARMOUR ULTRA to Break Through the Boundaries of Box Mod with Next-Level Power
articles.description: PARIS, Sept. 26, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Marking its 10th anniversary of innovation, VAPORESSO has launched the ARMOUR ULTRA, a groundbreaking DTL device that pushes the limits of traditional Box Mods. Positioned as the world's first 'Ultra Mod,' it combines a compact form with record-breaking battery life, rugged protection, and superior performance, setting a bold new standard for power and reliability.
